snippet.title: A Kiss from Death (Mystery Visual Novel) | Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to "A Kiss from Death", an immersive interactive fiction game set against the stunning backdrop of Sal, Cape Verde.

Unveil the unsettling secrets of Lucinda's enigmatic childhood friend and delve deeper into their true identity in this emotional visual novel game.

Play now: https://gongonstudio.itch.io/a-kiss-from-death

Follow our social media to stay updated!
Twitter: https://twitter.com/GongonStudio
Tumblr: https://gongonstudio.tumblr.com/
